verdict.rationale: Cline is a coding agent that also offers an integration engine and a hosted provider, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, the evidence documents none. The probe found 404s at all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths. The llms.txt and markdown docs index are documentation aids, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
